title: Adversarial Score Distillation: When score distillation meets GAN
tldr_zh: 把 SDS/VSD 重写为 WGAN 生成器损失：SDS 用固定次优判别器、VSD 判别器优化不完整；补全判别器损失后 2D/3D 蒸馏更稳。
tldr_en: ASD rederives SDS/VSD as WGAN generator losses with a diffusion-parameterized log-ratio discriminator, shows SDS uses a fixed suboptimal discriminator and VSD an incomplete update, and completes the discriminator loss.
key_numbers: Text-to-3D CLIP B/32: ASD 0.3314 vs SDS 0.3282 vs VSD 0.3203 (Table 1)
CLIP B/16: ASD 0.3376 vs SDS 0.3290 vs VSD 0.3258; CLIP L/14: SDS 0.2889 > ASD 0.2854 (Table 1)
User study ASD vs VSD: details 64.7% vs 35.3%, overall quality 65.5% vs 34.5% (Table 1)
NeRF distillation > 5 h on one A800; shared noise speeds up 30-50% (Sec. 7)
